runner.binding: verification-case-plan.json journey_definitions.real-comet-recovery (the registration is the binding; unknown journeys never fall into a default-success path)
runner.note: The runner is an action/observer adapter (verification_runner_invariant): it owns no phase, no recovery, no retries. The Comet engine owns the state machine — recovery is the runtime SDK's own store face (revision CAS + run_checkpoint + application identity) behind `comet runtime dispatch`, never a second controller.

sameRunCoordination.orderSemantics: execution-contract journey_execution.order_semantics: this window is injected inside the product Run BEFORE its completed step and recovered there; a fresh trial reruns the whole delivery/recovery trial, never splices fragments from different Runs
sameRunCoordination.boundaries: P3_3 lands the recovery recipe and the bounded composition-Run recovery slice only; the live Outline unknown-result resolution, independent external monitoring and backup qualification stay execution_owner=VERIFY (I07/I08/P4 mechanisms)

dispatchContract.trustedLauncher: Comet Runtime 0.5.0 (repo lock aeb1a659+0005, pinned build; fingerprint resolved from integrations/comet/upstream.lock.json at run time — never a pinned hash value here); the composition Run is owned by the sdd-managed-delivery application package and dispatch records are issued only by the Runtime
invariants: one open owner per action: a second claim of a claimed action is refused (ACTION_ALREADY_CLAIMED) and the same-identity re-claim is idempotent (H03/H06)
a mutation must bind the current Run revision: stale revisions are refused (REVISION_CONFLICT) and a replayed identical decision does no duplicate work
an old attempt/writer receipt cannot revive work: outcomes bind attempt+inputHash+claimToken (STALE_ACTION); restoring old package bytes after a drift restores the SAME run, never an old approval
the owning application package is immutable per Run: content drift is refused (WORKFLOW_CHANGED) on every face until the original bytes return
